domain_symbols.physical_field: fields and states in mathematical models of physics

rules.name: Newton second law rule
preconditions: The standard Newtonian point-particle model is active and mass is nonzero
rules.operation: Relate net force to acceleration in the basic Newtonian model.
examples: Given mass and net force, acceleration is determined by dividing by mass when mass is nonzero
counterexamples: Using the rule with zero mass in the same elementary form is invalid

rules.name: Heat equation seed
preconditions: The homogeneous diffusion model and Laplacian operator are defined
rules.operation: Model diffusion by equating time change to a Laplacian smoothing term.
examples: Temperature profiles smooth over time under heat-flow dynamics
counterexamples: Replacing the spatial Laplacian by a first derivative changes the model and is invalid here

rules.name: Wave equation seed
preconditions: The homogeneous wave model and Laplacian operator are defined
rules.operation: Model wave propagation with second-order time evolution driven by spatial Laplacian structure.
examples: Vibrating strings and membranes are idealized by wave-type second-order time equations
counterexamples: Using a first-order time derivative in place of u_tt is invalid for the standard wave equation

rules.name: Schrodinger equation seed
preconditions: A Hamiltonian operator and wavefunction setting are fixed
rules.operation: Model linear quantum time evolution through the Schrodinger equation.
examples: Hamiltonian operators generate unitary time evolution in the elementary quantum model
counterexamples: Dropping the imaginary unit changes the equation class and is invalid

rules.name: Einstein field equation seed
rules.output_form: G_mu_nu = 8 pi T_mu_nu in geometric units up to convention choices
preconditions: The active relativistic sign and constant conventions are fixed
rules.operation: Relate spacetime curvature to stress-energy in the standard general-relativistic tensor equation.
examples: Relativistic gravity couples geometry to matter through tensor equations rather than scalar force laws
counterexamples: Replacing the tensors by unrelated scalar quantities is invalid

rules.name: Action principle seed
preconditions: A variational formulation and admissible variation class are fixed
rules.operation: Characterize physical trajectories by stationarity of the action.
examples: Mechanics can be recast as an optimization-like stationarity problem for an action functional
counterexamples: Replacing stationarity by arbitrary pointwise minimization is invalid in general

rules.name: Euler-Lagrange equation seed
preconditions: The standard endpoint and smoothness hypotheses hold
rules.operation: Differentiate stationary action conditions into Euler-Lagrange equations.
examples: Variational mechanics produces differential equations by differentiating the action with respect to admissible path variations
counterexamples: Applying the Euler-Lagrange formula without the required endpoint or smoothness hypotheses is invalid

rules.name: Maxwell equation structural seed
rules.input_form: electric and magnetic field variables with sources
rules.output_form: coupled divergence and curl field equations
preconditions: The standard classical electromagnetic regime is active
rules.operation: Represent electromagnetic dynamics through Maxwell-type field equations.
examples: Electric and magnetic fields are coupled through field equations rather than treated as independent free variables
counterexamples: Dropping source terms or coupling structure without changing the physical regime is invalid

rules.name: Noether symmetry-conservation seed
preconditions: The standard Noether theorem hypotheses hold
rules.operation: Translate continuous action symmetries into conservation laws.
examples: Time-translation symmetry corresponds to energy conservation in classical variational mechanics
counterexamples: Inferring conservation laws from arbitrary transformations with no action symmetry is invalid

rules.name: Partition function seed
preconditions: A canonical ensemble and thermodynamic parameterization are fixed
rules.operation: Encode thermodynamic observables through partition-function structure.
examples: Free energy, expected energy, and fluctuation quantities can be derived from partition-function structure
counterexamples: Treating the partition function as a mere normalization constant with no observable content is invalid
